comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Part of the Dragons of Phantom Seas Memorial Album, this ship decoration is blue and can be crafted at Murshid in Candia once you have unlocked the Sea of Wonders -- it gives no stat boosts but looks nice.

Skill required: Handicrafts R15
Ingredients:

Platinum Ore x5
Marble x50
Phantom Monster's Relic x2

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Sea Dragon Tusks have no animation (sadly). For lightning, you want:

Sea Monster's Tusk
